messages:
Noah (CEO): Quick heads up: company all-hands this Friday 9:30am PT. Pls use this thread to drop Qs or submit anonymously: https://forms.redwood.company/allhands-q3-anon

Noah (CEO): Draft agenda: 1) Quick numbers + business context (5m) 2) GA launch announcement for "Redwood Dedicated v2" (10m) 3) Ops & reliability update, recent network partition summary (10m) 4) Policy update: expense & travel guidelines (5m) 5) People & hiring, new benefits (5m) 6) Live Q&A (15m)

Riya (CPO): For the GA section I'll show the deployment checklist and one customer case study. Planning a short demo of the admin routing controls (6m).

Diego (CTO): Ops update will include the network partition incident on 2024-12-12 and the follow-ups. I'll include the SLO impact numbers and the sticky mitigation we added. Want the postmortem link in the deck?

Zoe (Head of Ops): Yes please include it. Postmortem: https://confluence.redwood.company/incidents/2024-12-network-partition. TL;DR: BGP route flap in a partner region caused control-plane isolation; failover automation had a bug. Patch rolled, automation tests added.

Kai (People Ops): We'll announce expanded parental leave and a commuter stipend. If managers have questions about eligibility, flag them here before Thursday EOD.

EngineerA: Will the GA launch require any manual steps from runtime team for customers currently on v1?

Riya (CPO): Migration plan is staged; runtime team will get a migration runbook. We'll call out windows and rollback procedures in the doc.

Deploy Bot: Scheduled reminder: all-hands in 1 hour. Join: https://meet.redwood.company/allhands-q3

--- (meeting occurs) ---

AllHands Bot: Recording posted: https://videos.redwood.company/allhands-q3-1728504321.mp4

Noah (CEO): Thanks for joining. Main notes below, please correct if I missed something.

Noah (CEO): COMPANY UPDATE: Revenue growth steady, new large logos in EMEA, churn slightly below target. Investing more in SRE and platform reliability this quarter.

Riya (CPO): PRODUCT / LAUNCH: Redwood Dedicated v2 GA today. Key customer-facing changes: multi-tenant isolation improvements, improved autoscaling policies, reduced cold-starts. Beta customers in wave 0 will be migrated this week, general GA rollout starts Monday. Beta feedback form: https://forms.redwood.company/dedicated-v2-feedback

Riya (CPO): Demo highlights: new routing UI, per-route cost estimates, and one-click rollback. If you missed the demo, check the clip in the recording at 06:12.

Diego (CTO): INCIDENT SUMMARY: 2024-12-12 network partition caused ~18 minutes of control-plane errors for ~22% of requests in eu-west-3. Root cause: partner BGP flap + an edge-healthcheck edge case. Mitigations: fixed failover logic, added BGP monitoring, and introduced canary rollouts for control-plane changes. Postmortem link above.

Diego (CTO): Actionables for eng: 1) add BGP alert to infra pager (assigned: eng-infra), 2) runbook update for control-plane failover (assigned: eng-sre), 3) automate canary checks for control-plane deploys (assigned: runtime).

Zoe (Head of Ops): OPERATIONS: rolling out a new incident comms template and a faster postmortem cadence for sev2/3. Also starting a quarterly resilience review across infra and product owners.

Kai (People Ops): PEOPLE: new benefits effective next pay period: 12 weeks paid parental leave, $100/month commuter stipend for eligible US employees, and a refreshed mental health vendor. Hiring: prioritizing SRE, runtime engineers, and customer success hires.

Noah (CEO): POLICY: Expense & travel changes: per-diem cap updated, approvals required for bookings >$2k, and clearer criteria for partner region travel. Updated policy doc: https://docs.redwood.company/policies/expenses-v2

EngineerB: Quick Q: will the commuter stipend be pro-rated for part-time folks?

Kai (People Ops): Yes pro-rated based on FTE. I'll update the FAQ and post it in #people-ops.

EngineerC: For the control-plane canary checks, what's the expected false-positive rate?

Diego (CTO): We're targeting <1% FP initially, with a suppress window and manual override in the first 2 weeks. More details in the canary runbook.

Riya (CPO): LAUNCH FOLLOW-UPS: - Customer comms drafted and legal reviewed (marketing to send), - Migration runbook live: https://confluence.redwood.company/product/dedicated-v2-migration, - Support playbook updated (support team).

Noah (CEO): Q&A highlights: Q about pricing for Dedicated v2 -> no list-price change today; we'll offer an optional performance tier with a higher price in the future. Q about layoffs? -> No changes; business is hiring.

Diego (CTO): Technical note: runtime team please run the new control-plane canary script before next deploy:

```
./canary_controlplane --region eu-west-3 --checks 10 --threshold 0.99
```

Diego (CTO): Report any anomalies to eng-oncall and paste results in #eng-runtime for review.

Zoe (Head of Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Dedicated v2 GA today; migration starts this week. 2) Network partition postmortem & fixes applied; follow-up tasks assigned. 3) Policy updates for expenses & new people benefits. 4) Focus hires: SRE, runtime, CS.

Noah (CEO): Closing: big congrats to product, infra, and support teams on the launch. If you missed the live Q&A, watch the recording and add follow-ups here or in the anon form. :tada:
